_comment: Commercial product record for CAI-L4-CI-001 (reference product). Template and rules: config/agents/_template.json, docs/commercial-framework/README.md.
capabilities: Extracts parties, dates, notice periods, renewals and amendments from text-based English PDF contracts in one SharePoint library, each value with its location and the AI-extracted excerpt
Keeps the contract register in Dataverse; only reviewer-approved terms feed effective terms and deadlines
Recalculates notice deadlines daily (calendar calculation, month-based periods included) and answers register questions in Teams
useCases: Legal, procurement and finance teams on Microsoft 365 that track renewals and notice deadlines in spreadsheets
exclusions: Microsoft licences or Copilot Studio capacity
Installation or configuration done for the customer
Scanned-document OCR; languages other than English

licences: Power Platform environment with Dataverse (about 1 GB free)
Microsoft 365 with Teams for reviewer, admin and users
System Administrator role for the installer
microsoft.capacity: Copilot Studio capacity is mandatory: prepaid Copilot Credits or a pay-as-you-go billing plan linked to the environment; billed by Microsoft to the customer (INSTALL §1a)
installValues: five values in INSTALL §3 (library, owner team, reviewer, admin, recompute settings)
connections: three connection references bound at import (INSTALL §4)

permissions: CAI Contract Reader: read-only on Contracts and Field evidence, team-owned records only (INSTALL §2)
flows run as the installing System Administrator
agent reads with the signed-in user's identity
tenant.isolation: Per owner team: users read only their team's contracts and evidence (tested 9, 10 and 19 Nov 2026; INSTALL §10)
tenant.humanReview: Every extraction is confirmed or corrected by a named reviewer in Teams before it counts (INSTALL §9a)
governance: evidence excerpt and location stored per value
corrections kept beside the original evidence
agent not published by the import; admin-center check after every import (INSTALL §7)
